answer: Grader-stake-at-risk resists sybil grading: each grade carries a bond the grader forfeits if a later independent re-grade overturns it, so careless or colluding grades cost real capital. A beacon of confident collusion from a ring stakes bonds on verdicts a saffron-bright re-audit can reverse, draining the cartel. Honest graders rarely lose bonds because their grades hold up; a colluder stamping its members' junk watches the prism of re-grades shatter verdict after verdict, each overturn slashing another staked bond until collusion is simply unaffordable.
